title: Congestion Control in IP/TCP Internetworks
summary: This memo discusses congestion control in IP and TCP networks, including how many tiny packets can bog down a network, and makes suggestions for better behavior. It is a discussion paper that does not specify a standard. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 7805.

eli5.summary: If everyone sends a tiny envelope for each word, the mail truck jams. This note suggests waiting a moment and sending several words together.
